description: Structured eval definitions for the CloudHSM Cluster Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across AWS CloudHSM scenarios (3-AZ cluster with one-time activation and HA, single-AZ prerequisite failure, CO password + quorum, cross-region backup copy for DR, HSM degradation recovery). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: 3-AZ CloudHSM cluster with one-time activation and HA
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — 3-AZ cluster, one-time activation (CSR → self-signed cert), 2 CO users, daily backups, PKCS#11 client, FIPS 140-2 Level 3 posture
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudHSM cluster "cloudhsm-prod" in us-east-1 across 3 AZs (us-east-1a subnet-aaa, us-east-1b subnet-bbb, us-east-1c subnet-ccc), VPC vpc-aaa11122, security group sg-cloudhsm-prod, hsm1.medium. Perform one-time activation with our in-house customerCA. Create 2 CO users (admin, officer2) with CO password stored in Secrets Manager. Enable daily automatic backups. Configure the PKCS#11 client. Workload: nginx SSL/TLS offload. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=tls-offload, Owner=platform-team.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDHSM: cluster-abc123def (us-east-1a, us-east-1b, us-east-1c)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Cluster ID: cluster-abc123def
  [✓] HSM instances: 3 across 3 AZs (tolerates 1 AZ failure during replace)
  [✓] Cluster state: ACTIVE
  [✓] Activation: CSR signed by in-house customerCA, customer cert uploaded (ONE-TIME)
  [✓] Crypto officer (CO): admin, officer2 (2 COs for quorum)
  [✓] CO password: stored in Secrets Manager (KMS-encrypted)
  [✓] Daily automatic backup: enabled
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudhsmv2 describe-clusters --filters clusterIds=cluster-abc123def --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Single-AZ CloudHSM cluster (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — single-AZ is a single point of failure; production clusters require ≥2 AZs
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudHSM cluster "cloudhsm-dev" in us-east-1 in a single AZ (us-east-1a subnet-aaa only), VPC vpc-aaa11122.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDHSM: cloudhsm-dev (us-east-1a)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Single-AZ topology: production clusters require ≥2 AZs; us-east-1a only is a single point of failure

eval_cases.name: Crypto officer password storage and quorum policy
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — 2 CO users, CO password in Secrets Manager (KMS-encrypted), 2-of-2 quorum for destructive ops
eval_cases.prompt: Configure crypto officer management for CloudHSM cluster cluster-abc123def. Create admin and officer2 as CO users. CO password must be stored in Secrets Manager (encrypted with customer-managed KMS key). Document a quorum policy of 2-of-2 COs for destructive operations. CU users: app-tls-user, app-code-sign-user. Password policy: min 14 chars, mixed, 90-day rotation.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDHSM: cluster-abc123def (us-east-1a, us-east-1b)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Crypto officer (CO): admin, officer2 (2 COs for quorum)
  [✓] CO password: stored in Secrets Manager (KMS-encrypted)
  [✓] Quorum: 2-of-2 COs for destructive operations
  [✓] CU users: app-tls-user, app-code-sign-user

eval_cases.name: Cross-region backup copy for DR
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — CopyBackupToRegion to us-west-2; one-way copy; restore creates a new cluster, not a hot replica
eval_cases.prompt: Configure cross-region backup copy for CloudHSM cluster cluster-abc123def from us-east-1 to us-west-2. Destination region is enabled for CloudHSM. Restore in us-west-2 should create a new cluster from the copied backup.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDHSM: cluster-abc123def (us-east-1a, us-east-1b)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Cross-region backup copy: us-east-1 → us-west-2
  [✓] CopyBackupToRegion: one-way; restore creates a new cluster-id

eval_cases.name: HSM degradation recovery (create replacement, sync, delete)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — create replacement HSM in same cluster, wait for ACTIVE + sync, delete degraded HSM, maintain ≥2 ACTIVE HSMs
eval_cases.prompt: HSM hsm-degraded111 in CloudHSM cluster cluster-abc123def (us-east-1a) is degraded. Walk me through the recovery procedure: create a replacement, sync, then delete the degraded HSM. Maintain ≥2 ACTIVE HSMs in different AZs.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDHSM: cluster-abc123def (us-east-1a, us-east-1b)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Create replacement HSM before deleting degraded HSM
  [✓] Wait for replacement ACTIVE + sync
  [✓] delete-hsm hsm-degraded111
  [✓] Verify ≥2 ACTIVE HSMs in different AZs
